Definition: from G2462; an equestrian, i.e. member of a cavalry corps:--horseman.
BiblicalUsage: hippeús means horseman. It turns up twice, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hippeús plainly: horseman, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
